'''Smasher Armor''' was a type of personal [[battle armor]] produced by [[Locris Syndicates/Legends|Locris Syndicates]]. It was a modified version of the [[Personal Protection Suit]]. It was originally designed for private security personnel, but became a favorite of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]] that preferred hand-to-hand combat. It included numerous [[micro-servo]]s that greatly increased the wearer's physical abilities.
